name: add_shortlink_link_expiry
description: L3 repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): optional link expiry - schema field, POST validation, 410 Gone on the redirect path without recording the click
prompts: This is the express-ts-shortlink repo (TypeScript + Express, layered src/models, src/store, src/services, src/routes - see README.md; everything must keep compiling under `tsc -p .` strict). Add link expiry: POST /api/links accepts an optional `expiresAt` ISO timestamp string - reject anything that isn't a parseable date string with 400 - which is stored on the Link (add the field to the Link interface) and echoed in responses. From then on, GET /r/:slug for a link whose expiresAt is in the past must answer 410 with JSON body { 'error': 'link expired' } (double-quoted JSON on the wire, of course) instead of redirecting, and that expired hit must NOT be recorded as a click (stats stay unchanged). Links without expiresAt, and links whose expiry is still in the future, behave exactly as before, and an expired link's metadata/stats endpoints under /api/links stay readable.
